blocks.title: You know something’s wrong. You just can’t see where.
blocks.subtitle: Intelligence architecture · Autonomous operations · London, UK

blocks.content: The business works. But it’s heavy. It takes too many people, too many hours, too many decisions that shouldn’t need a human. You can feel the drag but you can’t point at the part that’s broken.

blocks.text: I find it. I show you. Then I fix it so it stays fixed — without you.
